data.name: Motioncade
data.detailed_description:
Motioncade is a motion-controlled arcade game collection where your phone becomes the controller.

Slash, shoot, fly, and compete through fast physical challenges built around real movement. Motioncade brings back the magic of motion-controlled party games using the devices you already own. No setup required, just connect your phone and jump in.

Arcade Modes

Saber

Deflect incoming blaster shots with quick reactions, or cut through enemy-filled levels with precise swings. Saber is built around the fantasy of holding a glowing blade and reacting in real time.

Fly

Pilot an airplane with your phone. Tilt, roll, pitch, and steer through fast aerial challenges with 6DOF motion controls.

Shoot

Aim your phone like a light gun and take down targets and zombies. Shoot is built for quick reflexes, clean aiming, and arcade-style chaos.

Fun Solo. Better with Friends

Motioncade is built for short, replayable challenges that are fun alone and even better with friends. Chase high scores, take turns, compete head-to-head, or pass the phone around the room.

The controls are easy to understand just by watching: swing too hard, overcorrect a plane, miss an easy shot, or clutch a perfect run.

No extra hardware required

Motion-controlled gameplay is now accessible to everyone by using the devices people already have. Your computer runs the game, and your phone becomes the controller.

Coming Soon. Wishlist For Updates!

Motioncade is currently in development, with more modes and multiplayer features planned over time, including co-op saber battles, airplane races and dogfights, western-style duels, and zombie horde challenges.

Wishlist Motioncade to follow development, demos, playtests, and new mode announcements.

data.short_description: Slash, shoot, fly, and compete with friends in a new kind of motion arcade game. Turn your phone into a motion controller and jump into a collection of fast, ridiculous arcade challenges. No equipment or setup required.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 / Intel Iris Xe or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a smartphone to use as a motion controller. PC and phone must be on the same Wi-Fi network.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated graphics / Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro 560 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a smartphone to use as a motion controller. PC and phone must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
